sentences.en: Good morning, and welcome to Oniton Hall, one of the largest estates in the area.
sentences.zh: 早上好，欢迎来到奥尼顿庄园，这是本地区最大的庄园之一。

sentences.en: My name's Nick, and I'm one of the guides.
sentences.zh: 我叫尼克，是这里的导游之一。

sentences.en: I'll give you a brief introduction to the estate while you're sitting down, and then we'll walk round.
sentences.zh: 在各位就座时，我先为大家简要介绍一下这座庄园，之后我们再一起参观。

sentences.en: The estate consists of the house, gardens, parkland and farm, and it dates back to the fourteenth century.
sentences.zh: 这座庄园包括主宅、花园、公园和农场，其历史可追溯至十四世纪。

sentences.en: The original house was replaced in the late seventeenth century, and of course it has had a large number of owners.
sentences.zh: 最初的宅邸于十七世纪晚期被重建，当然，它历经了众多主人。

sentences.en: Almost all of them have left their mark, generally by adding new rooms, like the ballroom and conservatory, or by demolishing others .
sentences.zh: 几乎每一位主人都留下了他们的印记，通常是通过增建新房间（如舞厅和温室），或拆除其他房间。

sentences.en: The farm looks much as it's always done, although the current owner has done a great deal of work to the flower beds.
sentences.zh: 农场外观基本保持原貌，尽管现任主人对花坛进行了大量修整。

sentences.en: In the seventeenth century, the estate was owned by a very wealthy man called Sir Edward Downes.
sentences.zh: 十七世纪时，庄园由一位名叫爱德华·唐斯爵士的非常富有的人士拥有。

sentences.en: His intention was to escape from the world of politics, after years as an active politician, and to build a new house worthy of his big collection of books, paintings and sculptures.
sentences.zh: 他原本是一位活跃的政治家，多年从政后，意图远离政界，并建造一座配得上其庞大藏书、绘画及雕塑收藏的新宅邸。

sentences.en: He broke off contact with his former political allies, and hosted meetings of creative and literary people, like painters and poets.
sentences.zh: 他中断了与昔日政治盟友的联系，并主办各类创意及文学人士聚会，例如画家与诗人。

sentences.en: Unusually for his time, he didn't care whether his guests were rich or poor, as long as they had talent.
sentences.zh: 在他那个时代，这实属罕见——他并不在意宾客是否富有或贫穷，只要他们具备才华即可。

sentences.en: Big houses like Oniton had dozens of servants until the 1920s or 30s, and we've tried to show what their working lives were like.
sentences.zh: 像奥尼顿这样的大型宅邸，直至二十世纪二三十年代仍雇有数十名仆人；我们努力还原了他们当时的工作生活状况。

sentences.en: Photographs of course don't give much of an idea, so instead, as you go round the house, you'll see volunteers dressed up as nineteenth-century servants, going about their work.
sentences.zh: 照片当然难以充分展现，因此，在您参观宅邸时，会看到身着十九世纪仆人服饰的志愿者，正从事各自的工作。

sentences.en: They'll explain what they're doing, and tell you their recipes, or what tools they're using.
sentences.zh: 他们会向您解释自己正在做的事情，并分享他们的食谱或所使用的工具。

sentences.en: We've just introduced this feature to replace the audio guide we used to have available.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚推出这一特色项目，以取代原先提供的语音导览。
